title: Crispy Argentinian Flaxseed Fritters with Velvety Salsa
description: A Mexican-inspired twist on traditional fritters, served with a side of creamy, velvety salsa.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flaxseed and argentinian flour.
Gradually add velvety, mixing until a dough forms.
Heat crispy oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of dough into the oil.
Fry fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve warm with a side of velvety salsa.
